§33.4 Recurrence Relations and Derivatives

For ℓ=1,2,3,…, let

33.4.1 Rℓ =1+η2ℓ2,
Sℓ =ℓρ+ηℓ,
Tℓ =Sℓ+Sℓ+1.
ⓘ

ℓ≥1,
